    Singular-pair disjointness #

    Use opposite-algebra reversal to turn common-second singular pairs into the common-first configuration excluded by the exact Figure-16 theorem. Combining the two orientations with the cross-position transit obstruction yields full singular-pair disjointness and hence a global zero-detecting normalized lift.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.CriticalFigure16Quotient.singularPair_eq_of_secondArrow_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSPairDichotomy S.ProjectiveCategory] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] [Infinite k] (hfinite : MildAlg k A) (hfiniteOp : MildAlg k Aᵐᵒᵖ) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.op.ProjectiveCategory] (p q : SingularPairNormalization.SingularPair) (hsecond : (↑p).secondArrow = (↑q).secondArrow) :
    p = q

    Two singular pairs with the same second arrow are equal, by reversing them over the opposite algebra and applying the common-first theorem.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.CriticalFigure16Quotient.singularPair_eq_of_sharedArrow {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSPairDichotomy S.ProjectiveCategory] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] [Infinite k] (hfinite : MildAlg k A) (hfiniteOp : MildAlg k Aᵐᵒᵖ) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.op.ProjectiveCategory] (p q : SingularPairNormalization.SingularPair) (hshare : (↑p).firstArrow = (↑q).firstArrow ∨ (↑p).firstArrow = (↑q).secondArrow ∨ (↑p).secondArrow = (↑q).firstArrow ∨ (↑p).secondArrow = (↑q).secondArrow) :
    p = q

    Any two singular pairs sharing an arrow in either position are equal.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.CriticalFigure16Quotient.exists_zeroDetectingNormalizedLift {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSPairDichotomy S.ProjectiveCategory] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] [Infinite k] (hfinite : MildAlg k A) (hfiniteOp : MildAlg k Aᵐᵒᵖ) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.op.ProjectiveCategory] [IsFiniteRayCategory S.RayCategory] :
    ∃ (L : BGRSRayArrowLift), ∀ {i j : RayVertex S.RayCategory} (p : Quiver.Path i j), L.pathMap p = 0 ↔ rayPathMap p = 0

    Representation-finiteness supplies a single representative of every irreducible ray arrow whose path map detects exactly the zero BGRS paths.
